page: Microsoft Azure M416ds_6_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MDSHighMemoryv3 family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by Intel processors, running under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 416 dedicated vCPUs and 5696.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of approximately 13.69 GB of RAM per core.

For storage, the server includes 410 GB of local SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput external disk attachments. It does not feature any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This hardware profile represents an extremely high-density resource allocation designed for massive scale-up workloads.

Given the massive memory capacity and high core count, this server is designed for large-scale enterprise databases, in-memory analytics, and heavy transactional workloads. The qualitative cost profile reflects its position as a premium, specialized tier of hardware optimized for consolidating massive datasets that exceed standard memory limits.
